transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling deeply depressed and completely exhausted, and lately, I've been hearing strange voices and feeling really paranoid. This has been going on for about 13 months now,
Have there been any times during these 13 months when the voices or paranoia continued even when your depression was not present or had gotten much better?

Yes, there have definitely been times like that. There was a period of about two or three weeks where the voices and the feeling of being watched stayed just as strong, even though my mood had temporarily lifted and I wasn't feeling as depressed.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks when the voices or paranoia were present by themselves, without any depression at all?

Yes, there was a stretch of about two weeks where I didn't feel depressed at all, but the voices and paranoia were still fully there. My mood was actually okay during that time, but the hallucinations and fears just wouldn't stop.
Have you ever had any periods of mania or hypomania, such as needing much less sleep, feeling unusually energized or confident, or talking much more than usual?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I've never had times where I felt unusually energized or didn't need sleep—if anything, I'm always feeling completely exhausted and drained.
When the voices and paranoia happen, do they usually occur only during your depressive episodes, or have they also happened when you were not depressed?

Usually, the voices and paranoia happen at the same time I'm feeling deeply depressed. But there have definitely been times, lasting for at least two weeks, where my mood had improved but the voices and paranoia were still fully there.
Have the voices or paranoia ever continued for at least 2 weeks when you were not depressed at all?

Yes, definitely. There was a period of about two weeks where my mood felt completely fine and I wasn't depressed at all, but the voices and the feeling of being monitored didn't go away. It was very strange to still experience all of that without the heavy sadness.
Have you ever had any periods of mania or hypomania, such as needing much less sleep, feeling unusually energized or confident, or talking much more than usual?

No, I have never experienced anything like that. I've never had times where I felt unusually energized, needed less sleep, or talked excessively. If anything, my energy is always extremely low and I feel completely drained.
Have your depressive symptoms ever lasted for most of the illness, with the voices or paranoia only occurring during those depressive episodes?

Yes, the depression has definitely been there for the vast majority of the time over this past year. However, the voices and paranoia don't only happen when I'm depressed, as they have also occurred on their own for at least a couple of weeks when my mood was actually okay.

Based on what you've told me, the pattern fits schizophrenia more than schizoaffective disorder, because the psychotic symptoms have occurred for at least 2 weeks without depression. Does that sound accurate to you?
I'm not really sure about the medical terms or how the diagnoses differ. I just know that both the heavy depression and the voices have been completely taking over my life for over a year now.
